faqs.a: Hautezelle Studio is a luxury resin art studio in Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria, founded by Zainab Yinusa. We handcraft personalised resin wedding plaques, clocks, bags, stationery and gifts, and we teach resin art through the Hautezelle Academy and Resin N Sip workshops.

faqs.q: How do I order from Hautezelle?
faqs.a: Send a DM to @hautezelle on Instagram with the piece you want, your names or text, colours and date. Every piece is handmade to order. You can also chat with us on WhatsApp or email hautezelle@gmail.com.

faqs.q: How much does a resin wedding plaque cost in Nigeria?
faqs.a: At Hautezelle, mini wedding plaques start from ₦35,000, acrylic wedding plaques from ₦45,000, resin wedding plaques from ₦65,000 and full resin wedding platter sets from ₦130,000. The final price depends on size and personalisation.

faqs.q: Can you add names, dates, Arabic calligraphy or Quran verses?
faqs.a: Yes. Our wedding plaques are personalised with the couple's names, wedding date and a verse or message of your choice, including Arabic calligraphy such as Quran 30:21.

faqs.q: Do you take bulk and corporate orders?
faqs.a: Yes. We make wedding souvenirs, staff gifts and branded items in bulk. Keychains and bookmarks are ₦6,000 each, ₦5,000 each for orders above 50 and ₦4,000 each for 100 pieces or more. Named resin pens start from ₦2,500 and keychain and pen gift boxes from ₦7,500.

faqs.q: Can I learn resin art at Hautezelle?
faqs.a: Yes. The Hautezelle Academy offers online courses and in studio workshops in Ilorin. The Foundation starts from ₦150,000, Business of Art from ₦250,000 and the Masterclass from ₦500,000, with certification included.

Resin N Sip is our relaxed resin art event where you enjoy drinks while making your own resin piece with guidance. All materials are provided and you take your art home. It works well for team bonding, bridal showers and birthdays.

faqs.q: Where is Hautezelle Studio and when is it open?
faqs.a: Our studio is in Ilorin, Kwara State, Nigeria, and is open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Send us a DM on Instagram to arrange a visit.
